licences.title: Licences, certificates and documents
licences.subtitle: Every licence and registration a company needs, with its portal, number, expiry and the papers behind it · reminders before anything lapses · Admin only
licences.dialogHint: Type the number and dates exactly as printed on the licence. For a renewal use Renew on the licence, so the old dates stay in its history.
licences.toHelp: Leave empty if it has no expiry.
licences.ranReminders: Reminder run done: {{n}} sent to owners, {{s}} recorded as covered by a nearer one, {{e}} lapsed licences sent to the Bug fixer.

kpi.remindersSub: days before expiry, to the licence owner

licences.footnote: Every number, date and certificate is entered from the original papers. A lapsed licence that a step depends on stops that step, for example packing or production when Admin marks it as blocking.
licences.emptyBody: Production of cosmetics and other licensed products is blocked until Admin records the licence here.
licences.adminOnly: Only Admin records licences. Ask Admin to add or renew one.

f.title: Title (optional)
f.titleHelp: e.g. the state or the product line it covers.
f.blocksHelp: Leave both empty if a lapse should only warn.

detail.title: {{name}} · papers and history
detail.noReminders: No reminder has been due yet.

doc.title: Add a document
doc.hint: The file goes to this company's private licences folder. Only people who can see the company can open it.

renew.title: Renew the licence
renew.hint: Enter the renewed licence exactly as printed. The old number and dates stay in the renewal history.

folders.title: Document folders · this company
folders.machinesSub: Bills, warranties, service and calibration papers, on Asset register
folders.othersSub: Company papers, contracts and insurance folders are not built yet

how.title: How the folder works
how.one: Each document sits under its company and folder, with its number, issue date and expiry.
how.rem: The licence owner gets a reminder at each of the reminder days before expiry, once each.
how.link: A licence a step needs is checked at that step: no production or packing on a lapsed blocking licence.
how.who: Admin and the CA see everything; others see only the company they work for.
how.lost: Old values are kept when a licence is renewed; every change is in the transaction log.
